thread:
sam: Hi finance team, quick one from my trip to Amsterdam. The corporate card shows a charge from EuroDrive for 285.40 EUR and a separate "CONCESSION RECOVERY" 38.00 EUR line. My emailed receipt is a single total and a short confirmation number; no line-by-line folio. Need an itemized invoice for VAT reclaim and to confirm which charges are reimbursable. What should I do?

zoe: Hi Sam 60a please attach the PDF and the card statement lines. We'll need reservation number and whether any extras (gps, child seat, insurance) were added at pickup. If concession recovery looks like an airport fee we usually need the vendor folio to justify.

sam: Uploaded files to expense EXP-2025-124. Reservation: AD-443210. Card descriptor: EURODRIVE*AD443210 / txn id 2203-774. I declined all extras except an automatic toll handling option they said would be charged after return.

rahul: If toll handling was accepted that's probably the separate batch. For VAT reclaim we require a VAT-compliant invoice showing VAT line and supplier tax id. Ask EuRoDrive for a "rental folio or invoice with VAT breakdown" and include EXP-2025-124 in the subject. If they refuse, we can either: 1) open a card dispute for the concession line (recovery), or 2) treat the vendor receipt as the primary supporting doc but that may block VAT reclaim.

sam: Drafted email to vendor: ```Subject: EXP-2025-124 - Request for VAT invoice for reservation AD-443210
Hello,
Could you please supply a VAT-compliant invoice or folio for reservation AD-443210 that breaks out base rental, VAT, tolls, and any concession/recovery fees? The charge posted to our corporate card on 2025-06-14 (txn id 2203-774). We need this for VAT reclaim and reimbursement.
Thanks,
Sam (Redwood Inference)``` Any edits?

zoe: Looks good. Add the company name and VAT number to the email if the vendor requires it for invoicing. Also CC finance@redwood.ai. If they reply with a generic receipt, reply again requesting a folio showing supplier tax id and VAT percent.

sam: Sent and got an autoresponse: "Thanks, we'll respond within 7 business days." Ugh.

expensebot: Expense EXP-2025-124 status updated to vendor-requested.

zoe: OK we'll wait 7bd. If no itemized invoice after that, we'll escalate. Rahul - can you pre-fill the dispute request if it comes to that?

rahul: On it. One more thing for Sam 51c: please add a short note in the expense about the agent's explanation of the concession fee at pickup (e.g., "agent said airport concession recovery due to terminal location"). Manager approval for dispute?

sam: Manager approved for escalation if vendor doesn't provide folio. Note added: "agent said concession recovery is airport access surcharge; tolls handled post-return." Thanks all :thumbsup:

zoe: Final checklist for the thread: [Receipt PDF attached], [Card txn id provided], [Reservation AD-443210], [Vendor folio requested], [Manager pre-approved for dispute]. Will update when vendor replies or dispute initiated.

sam: Appreciated!
